title: Kabir and the Golden Gear
logline: To find a legendary 1950s time capsule hidden deep beneath his school, a ten-year-old boy with dyslexia must use his unique spatial skills to navigate a shifting subterranean maze that only makes sense when the letters move.

beats.title: The Missing Piece
beats.summary: Kabir works on his ultimate masterpiece, a motorized toy crane, but realizes he needs a rare vintage brass gear only found in the school's legendary, lost 1950s time capsule.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir visualizes the entire crane's internal mechanics in perfect three-dimensional space, though he cannot read the printed instruction manual.

beats.title: The Archive Discovery
beats.summary: While searching the school library's history corner, Kabir finds an old, dusty blueprint of the school's forgotten basement tunnels.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir struggles with the library catalog system's letter-sound codes, but instantly recognizes the geometric patterns on the old map.

beats.title: The Classroom Test
beats.summary: In English class, Kabir is called on to read aloud from a history textbook. He feels the pressure but uses his folding ruler to ground himself.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir experiences phonological processing difficulties, struggling to blend letter sounds like 'str' and 'ch', but his teacher accommodates his visual style.

beats.title: The Shifting Map
beats.summary: During recess, Kabir and his friend Leo study the blueprint. Leo sees only a messy, overlapping set of misaligned letters and lines.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir's dyslexia allows him to see the overlapping letters not as static mistakes, but as moving spatial layers that align into a path.

beats.title: Into the Deep
beats.summary: Kabir and Leo slip past the dusty boiler room door and enter the cold, brick-lined tunnels beneath the school.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir uses his canvas satchel and his spatial memory to navigate the dark, winding corridors without getting lost.

beats.title: The Gear Gate
beats.summary: They encounter a heavy brass gate locked with an alphabetical dial. The letters must be aligned to form a specific sound sequence.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir struggles to sound out the words phonetically, but he visualizes the letters as interlocking gear teeth to solve the physical mechanism.

beats.title: The Rotating Tunnel
beats.summary: The tunnel walls physically rotate, changing the layout of the maze. Leo panics as the exit disappears.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir uses his three-dimensional spatial awareness to track their movement, clicking his folding ruler to measure the angles of rotation.

beats.title: The Chamber of Echoes
beats.summary: They reach a chamber with speaking tubes. A voice recording plays a series of complex phonemic clues to open the next door.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir utilizes his exceptional auditory memory, recalling the exact sequence of spoken sounds he heard once to match them to the carved wall runes.

beats.title: The Coal Vault
beats.summary: They find the old coal vault. In the center sits the rusted steel time capsule from 1954.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir uses his folding ruler to pry open the seized latch of the capsule, showing his practical engineering skills.

beats.title: The Prize Secured
beats.summary: Inside the capsule, among old photos and newspapers, Kabir finds the pristine, gold-plated vintage gear he needs.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir ignores the printed text of the old newspapers but perfectly deciphers the physical diagram stamped on the gear box.

beats.title: The Custodian's Shadow
beats.summary: The heavy footsteps of Mr. Henderson, the custodian, echo down the hall. They must escape quickly.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir quickly maps a new exit route through an old coal chute by visualizing the school's structural layout in his head.

beats.title: The Crane Ascends
beats.summary: Back in his workshop, Kabir successfully integrates the golden gear into his crane. It works flawlessly.
beats.trait_in_play: Kabir still struggles to read the written project label, but his crane is a masterpiece of engineering, showing his intelligence is independent of his reading speed.

trait_causality_note: Kabir's dyslexia allows him to perceive the overlapping, misaligned letters on the blueprint not as a static error, but as shifting three-dimensional layers that map out the physical maze.
